# Acid Concepts - LLMs.txt
# AI-readable site index for language model agents

## Site Overview
Acid Concepts is an interactive technology and venture studio specializing in immersive digital experiences, custom software development, AI systems, and launching new ventures. Based in Indianapolis with global reach.

## Key Pages

- URL: /
- Description: Main landing page showcasing services, featured projects, technology capabilities, and company overview. Start here for a complete introduction to Acid Concepts.

## In-House Products
Acid Concepts builds and operates proprietary products:
- 11Hype: Sports and entertainment fan engagement platform
- Orylu: Digital experience platform
- The Vault by Acid: Secure digital asset management

## AI Assistant
ARIA (Interactive Digital Strategist and Venture Architect) is available on the website to answer questions about services, projects, and capabilities.

## Technical Capabilities
- Interactive Installations (touchscreens, gesture recognition, motion tracking)
- Custom Software Development (React, TypeScript, Node.js)
- AI/ML Integration (conversational AI, computer vision, recommendation systems)
- Real-time Data Visualization
- Hardware-Software Integration
- Cloud Architecture (AWS, Supabase)
